app.title: Splitly — Private Video Splitter & Audio Extractor
app.description: Split large videos by size or extract lightweight audio for NotebookLM, Discord, or WhatsApp. 100% private, runs entirely in your browser.
app.heroSubtitle: Split videos by file size or extract lightweight M4A audio for NotebookLM, Discord, WhatsApp, or email — all processed directly on your device.

video.title: Split Video
video.subtitle: Split video parts preserving picture & sound
video.hint: Splits the video into parts according to your size limit, preserving the original video and audio streams without re-encoding whenever possible.

audio.title: Extract Audio
audio.subtitle: High-fidelity M4A / AAC audio for NotebookLM & sharing
audio.hint: Extracts high-fidelity AAC audio in a compact M4A container (~30–45 MB for a 1.5-hour recording). Perfect for NotebookLM source limits, transcripts, and mobile listening.

dropzone.title: Drop your videos here
dropzone.hint: MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI, M4V · up to ~2 GB per file · processed locally
dropzone.dragOver: Drop files to add to queue

controls.sizeHelp: A small safety margin is applied to keep each piece strictly within platform limits.
controls.concurrencyHelp: Parallel processing requires more browser RAM. 1 at a time is strongly recommended for files over 300 MB.

queue.title: Your files

statusText.adjustingPart: Adjusting part {part} to stay within limit…
statusText.partsCreated: {count, plural, one {1 part created} other {# parts created}}
statusText.audioReady: {count, plural, one {1 audio file ready} other {# audio files ready}}
statusText.videoReady: {count, plural, one {1 video part ready} other {# video parts ready}}

queue.downloadAll: {count, plural, one {Download result} other {Download all # parts}}
queue.largeFileWarn: Large file (>800 MB): runs best with 1 at a time to prevent memory exhaustion

actions.summaryEmpty: Add one or more videos to get started
actions.summaryProcessing: Processing {active, plural, one {1 video} other {# videos}} · Keep this tab open
actions.summaryCompleted: All finished · {count, plural, one {1 file completed} other {# files completed}}
actions.summaryReady: {count, plural, one {1 video} other {# videos}} ready · {size} total

private.title: Your files never leave your device
private.description: All conversion happens right in your browser via WebAssembly. Zero video bytes are sent to any cloud or remote server.

notebooklm.title: Optimized for NotebookLM
notebooklm.description: Extract crystal-clear audio that fits into a single source upload, saving quota and processing time.

batch.title: Individual or Batch Queue
batch.description: Process a single meeting recording or queue dozens of lecture videos at your own pace.

preview.unsupported: Your browser cannot preview this specific format directly, but you can download it to play locally.
